newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu to invest $120 mln to build Vietnam plant.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu to invest $120 mln to build Vietnam plant.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Wednesday that it would invest $120 million to build a plant in Vietnam for the production of motherboards for personal computers (PCs).
The plant, to be built in Bien Hoa, near Ho Chi Minh City, will start operations in July 1998, a company spokesman said.
Construction will start in July and be completed in April 1998. The plant is expected to produce 7.6 million motherboards in 2000, he said.

The spokesman said Fujitsu's Akashi plant in western Japan, which currently produces motherboards, will concentrate on the production of higher-grade motherboards after the opening of the Bien Hoa plant.
Fujitsu already operates one plant in Vietnam which assembles PC motherboards.
